Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

officer noun

a commander in the armed forces

also officers, army officer, military officer, colonel, company commander, cavalry officer

classical

Traupman 187: officer, praefectus; cavalry officer, praefectus equitum

praefectus, praefectī m.

noun, second declension

a commander, an officer

Other words

  • tribūnus mīlitum — a military tribune, a senior officer of a legion

    also used · classical · Gell. 9.11.7: super galeam tribūnī īnsistit; Traupman 186: colonel

  • centuriō, centuriōnis m. — a centurion, commander of a century

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.40 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 186: company commander

  • officiārius, officiāriī m. — an officer

    noun, second declension · also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. officer (military) (Tursellinus, 1652)

Examples

  • corvus repentē inprōvīsus advolat et super galeam tribūnī īnsistit

    suddenly, out of nowhere, a raven flies up and settles on the tribune’s helmetGell. 9.11.7

See also army, soldier, military, police officer, official.

SourcesLewis & Short: praeficio · Lewis & Short: tribunus · Lewis & Short: centurio

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 186–187.

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. officer (military).
